analysis.headline: Shares Your Data For Ads
analysis.quote: These activities–disclosing unique IDs and disclosing data through Cookies–may constitute “targeted advertising”, “sharing”, or “selling” under certain privacy laws, and depending on where you live, we may require your consent or you may be able to opt out of such activities.

analysis.headline: Trains AI On Your Content
analysis.quote: We also use information we collect to train our AI models. You can decide whether Superhuman can use your user content to train our AI models by adjusting the available training control(s) in your account settings.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Access Your Data
analysis.quote: If you choose to use a third-party offering, Superhuman may disclose information to that third party and/or an associated API provider in accordance with your settings.

analysis.headline: Infers Data About You
analysis.quote: Finally, we may infer information about you based on the information we collect. For example, we may make inferences about your approximate location based on your IP address, predict that you are interested in certain products we offer based on your usage data and past purchases, and, depending upon your account settings, we may infer what industry you work in and your writing style based on your use of our products.

analysis.headline: Collects Others' Data Via You
analysis.quote: Your user content may include information about others, such as when you exchange emails with people who don’t use our products or if you choose to give our products access to your contacts so our editing products make appropriate spelling suggestions.

analysis.headline: Employer Controls Your Data
analysis.quote: If you use our products under the management of a company, organization, or other legal entity (such as if your employer gives you access to our inbox assistant tools for work), this Privacy Policy won’t apply to the information you upload to or output from our products (Customer Personal Data, as defined in our Data Privacy Addendum ).

analysis.headline: Your Data Transferred Internationally
analysis.quote: We may transfer and process your data outside of the country where you live. Countries’ data protection laws vary, with some providing more protection than others.
